description: High-converting, small-batch artisanal ice cream e-commerce platform with interactive flavor showcase hero slider, custom sundae builder, dynamic shopping cart and checkout, and dynamic customer reviews/comments system.

userStories.title: Interactive Hero Slider with Serving Size Selection
userStories.description: As a customer visiting the site, I want to explore core artisan flavors with 3D flying scoops, particles, and choose my portion size so that I can add it directly to my bag.
acceptanceCriteria: Framer Motion animations for title, image, particles, and upcoming preview stack work smoothly
Serving size selector (Single Scoop, Double, Pint, Tub) updates displayed price dynamically
Add to Cart triggers immediate visual toast confirmation
Next and Prev controls and keyboard arrows cycle flavors without trapping page scroll
Typecheck and Vite build pass

userStories.title: Shop Catalog with Search, Category and Dietary Filters
userStories.description: As a shopper, I want to filter by category (Signature, Bundles, Vegan) and dietary preferences (Gluten-Free, Organic, Nut-Free) and search keywords so that I find my ideal frozen treat.
acceptanceCriteria: Search bar filters by name, ingredient, and category in real time
Dietary pill filters allow multi-selection (Gluten-Free, Organic, etc.)
Sorting dropdown handles price (asc/desc), ratings, and popularity
Product cards display badges, ratings, quantity stepper, and quick view details trigger
Typecheck and Vite build pass

userStories.title: Interactive Custom Sundae Builder
userStories.description: As an ice cream lover, I want to create a custom sundae by selecting 1 or 2 scoop flavors, a waffle cone or bowl, warm drizzle, and crunch toppings with live price calculation.
acceptanceCriteria: Step 1 selects 1-2 base scoop flavors with colored swatches
Step 2 selects serving vessel (Crispy Waffle Cone, Choco Cone, Cup, Brioche)
Step 3 selects artisan drizzle (Hot Fudge, Salted Caramel, Berry Coulis)
Step 4 selects toppings with multi-select checkboxes
Live summary card computes total price dynamically and adds customized creation with detailed recipe notes to cart
Typecheck and Vite build pass

userStories.title: Dynamic Customer Reviews & Comments UI
userStories.description: As a customer, I want to read verified customer reviews, filter by star rating and flavor, vote reviews as helpful, write my own review with interactive stars and taste tags, and reply to existing reviews.
acceptanceCriteria: Aggregate average rating and star breakdown bars update dynamically when reviews are added
Interactive 5-star rating selector with hover preview sentiment labels
Review submission form adds review immediately to state and persists to localStorage
Helpful upvote button increments count and animates with animejs
Inline reply form allows nested replies to any review thread
Filter reviews by stars, flavor, and search keywords
Typecheck and Vite build pass
userStories.notes: Implemented in src/components/DynamicReviews.jsx using animejs for micro-interactions and localStorage persistence

userStories.title: Slide-Out Cart Drawer and Simulated Multi-Step Checkout
userStories.description: As a buyer, I want to view my cart drawer, adjust quantities, see a free-shipping progress meter, apply promo codes (SCOOPY20), choose tip amount, and complete a simulated checkout with celebratory confetti.
acceptanceCriteria: Cart drawer slides in with backdrop blur and responsive layout
Quantity steppers increment/decrement and remove items when reduced to zero
Free cold-chain shipping progress meter recalculates against $35 threshold
Promo code engine validates SCOOPY20 (20% off), SWEET5 ($5 off), and FREESHIP
Multi-step checkout collects cold delivery address, express 45-min courier slot, and payment method
Confetti explosion triggers via canvas-confetti upon order confirmation and issues a live tracking order ID
Cart and wishlist persist in localStorage
Typecheck and Vite build pass
userStories.notes: Implemented in CartContext.jsx, CartDrawer.jsx, and CheckoutModal.jsx
